context.en: This Qing portrait commemorates Li Mu, the commander whose training and defensive policy shape the frontier account.
context.zh: 这幅清代画像纪念李牧，即边防叙事中主持训练与守备的将领。

context.en: Li Mu’s composed pose and official dress belong to a Qing remembrance of the commander who received the title Lord Wu’an.
context.zh: 李牧沉静的姿态与官员服饰，属于清人对这位受封武安君的将领的追忆。

context.en: A Qing remembrance of Li Mu accompanies the Shiji’s account of his removal and Zhao’s final defeat.
context.zh: 清人追绘的李牧像，与《史记》中他被撤杀及赵国最终败亡的叙事并读。

context.en: The Ming inscription identifies Wang Jian as Qin’s great general. The portrait gives the named commander a place in later memory, while the Shiji provides the campaign sequence.
context.zh: 明代题字称“秦大将军王翦”。画像呈现将领的后世记忆，战役先后则依据《史记》叙事。

context.en: The Ming portrait names Bai Qi “Lord Wu’an of Qin.” Read this later honorific image alongside the Shiji’s account of conquest and mass killing.
context.zh: 明代画像题名“秦武安君白起”。可将这幅以封号纪念人物的后世图像，与《史记》中的征服和杀戮记载并读。

context.en: This Ming portrait names Sun Bin, the adviser in the Shiji’s Maling account: a later commemoration of the strategist.
context.zh: 这幅明代画像题名孙膑，是对《史记》马陵叙事中这位军师的后世纪念。

context.en: This 1893 illustrated-history image identifies Huan Wen, whose staff Xie An joined. It helps distinguish the two political figures; it does not depict the appointment in 360.
context.zh: 这幅1893年绣像历史作品标识桓温，即谢安入幕所事之人。图像帮助分辨两位政治人物，并不表现360年的任职现场。
